info.title: UniCAS Tenant API
info.description: Tenant data-plane API for immutable CAS nodes, leases, usage, garbage collection, and signed Root Ref updates.

tags.name: Nodes
tags.description: Read immutable nodes and establish or extend upload leases.

tags.name: Root Refs
tags.description: Read and atomically update capability-scoped Root Ref balances.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: Inspect tenant usage and run bounded garbage collection.

get.description: Streams the canonical bytes for a ready content-addressed node.
Returns immutable node metadata together with current lease and reference state.

post.description: Extends a ready node lease, or reserves an upload and returns upload instructions.

get.description: Returns node, content-byte, reservation, and lease counters for one tenant.

post.description: Examines unreferenced, unleased nodes and reclaims eligible stored content.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated snapshot of balances in the capability's refDomain.

post.description: Atomically applies idempotent balance changes in the capability's refDomain.
